proof_body:
by
  intro G _ p n hp hn hG
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hpos : Nat.card G ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hG]
    exact pow_ne_zero n hp.ne_zero
  haveI : Finite G := Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero hpos
  haveI : Nontrivial G := by
    apply Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp
    rw [hG]
    exact Nat.one_lt_pow hn.ne' hp.one_lt
  exact (IsPGroup.of_card hG).center_nontrivial
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (p n : ℕ), p.Prime → 0 < n → Nat.card G = p ^ n → Nontrivial (Subgroup.center G)
